summary: Every person the solution reasons about (Renner, Petra, Dmitri, Yuki) is present in the cast, but the central deduction rests on a timing claim that the mystery's own data contradicts: the archive was entered at 2209 while Renner's terminal was still logging keystrokes, his unlogged gap not beginning until 2218. Secondary faults — planting the keycard in a room Dmitri never left, a twelve-minute window that must also contain scene-staging and an exterior wrench disposal, and key_evidence that names two clues which do not identify the culprit — compound the failure.

findings.claim: No player prompt was stored with this scenario, so delivery against request cannot be judged; section D is reported and skipped.
findings.citation: "_meta": { "num_players": 4, "setting_input": "Antarctic research station, present day, six-week winter lockdown" }

findings.claim: There is no solution.chain field and no evidence item carries supports/exonerates/implicates labels, so B and C were audited against solution.how_to_deduce and the "relevance" tags only.
findings.citation: "how_to_deduce": "Step 1 — Establish who was physically at the archive: E1 (door-control log) shows Dmitri's keycard accessed the archive at 2209."

findings.claim: Renner cannot have made the 2209 archive swipe: his keystroke log runs continuously from 2130 except for the 2218–2230 gap, so at 2209 the station's own record places him typing in the communications room.
findings.citation: "He used Dmitri's card to enter the archive at 2209" / "the terminal logs show a twelve-minute gap between 2218 and 2230 with no keystrokes recorded"

findings.claim: Step 2 of the deduction asserts the terminal gap coincides with the archive access, which is false by nine minutes and by the four-minute door-open period (2209–2213) that ends before the gap begins.
findings.citation: "E5 (terminal gap) shows Renner had an unlogged twelve-minute absence from the communications room precisely when the archive was accessed."

findings.claim: Renner cannot plant the keycard beneath Generator B unseen, because Dmitri is placed in that room continuously across the entire relevant period and the solution never states when the planting occurred.
findings.citation: "He returned Dmitri's keycard to the generator-room drainage channel" / "Says he was performing a scheduled maintenance cycle on Generator B from 2100 to 2345"

findings.claim: The twelve-minute window cannot hold three minutes of walking plus the killing, the staging of an accidental fall, the trip to the generator room, and a trip to an exterior hatch in a module buried under three metres of snow at minus sixty.
findings.citation: "He disposed of the wrench by dropping it into an exterior equipment hatch that vents to the sub-surface snow pack" / "The archive is a ninety-second walk from the communications room through the connecting tunnel."

findings.claim: key_evidence names E1 and E2, but E1 points at Dmitri and E2 only proves fraud; neither places Renner at the archive, and the clues that actually carry the solution (E4, E5) are demoted to "supporting".
The elimination step ignores Bjorn, whose whereabouts before 2234 are unevidenced, so the claim that only Renner had an evidenced opportunity is unproven.
findings.citation: "No other suspect has an evidenced absence in a location adjacent to the archive during that window." / "His bunk-module motion sensor logged his presence continuously from 2234 until 0329."

findings.claim: The archive door is found unlocked with the light on, but the access log states the door re-locked four minutes after the only swipe, and nothing in the solution accounts for the door being left open.
findings.citation: "found the archive door unlocked and the light on" / "the door remaining open for four minutes before re-locking"

findings.claim: The stated reason for killing at that hour collapses because Renner was sitting at the very terminal holding the outgoing mail cache and could have verified the report was already sent before acting.
findings.citation: "he believed killing Petra before the 0600 radio window would allow him to access her terminal and delete the draft. Discovering the email was already in the sent cache, which he checked after returning to the communications room"

findings.claim: Dmitri runs a full maintenance cycle and signs off at 2341 without ever missing his master keycard, and the station's core handler somehow works the archive daily without archive access rights.
findings.citation: "His keycard is the only one on station besides Petra's own that is coded for unsupervised archive access" / "Field technician Bjorn Haugen went to retrieve a core sample for an early-morning analysis run"

findings.claim: E8 is described as demolishing Yuki's alibi on a five-minute discrepancy that is trivially compatible with her account of starting work at 2000.
findings.citation: "was actually submitted as an automated overnight run at 1955 — before Yuki claims she began working"

findings.claim: E10 is tagged red_herring but the print near the archive door was most plausibly left by the killer himself, and the item's own text concedes it is non-attributable while still claiming it points at Dmitri.
findings.citation: "Comparison of boot soles from all station personnel initially suggests a match to Dmitri's standard-issue station boots — but the same V-tread pattern is issued to all four winter-over personnel"
